_doc: Chip floorplan B (rev 1). Rectangles in um, row-aligned (rows at y = 3.92 + 3.92 r, r = 0..38) and site-aligned (x = 3.36 + 0.56 k; endcaps occupy sites 0-1 and 605-606, so placeable x is 4.48..342.16). Expected area = in-context synthesized area of the cluster's flat cells (connectivity/h2_attribution.json) + its h2-attributed PnR reserve (area/h2_pnr_by_module.json: upsizing + repair buffers; CTS buffers split by flop count). Ties are tool-placed (repair_tie_fanout) under their pins in row 38.

ctrl.kind: control cluster (controller FSM + flash SPI master + ties)
